text: Web: editing an equal-split expense zeroes a frozen participant's share, so every save is refused

Fixed in 4742bee: shareStateFrom seeds a frozen participant from the stored map whichever the split was, mirroring Android startEdit/frozenShares; applies to a stored expense only (a prefill is a change from zero for anyone frozen anyway, as on Android). Two new ExpenseListPage tests (a voter, a former member): stored share shown and pushed unchanged; both fail with the one-line fix reverted. Full gate green on main.
